method: Paid DeepSpace CLI calls to anthropic/chat-completion, billed to the developer account. Each pose was built from the cue note and photographed by the stage's own photographActor. Vision requests were byte-for-byte the shipped ones: claude-haiku-5-5, max_tokens 3000, the shipped brief, a random comic angle and the night's mood, with no cue, filename or answer list. The referee requests used claude-haiku-4-5, temperature 0 and the shipped prompt. One look per frame; in the game Stubbs gets five and is told his earlier misses.

calls.title: Singing karaoke
calls.line: Singing into a mic, is it? [sarcastic] Lovely grip, nearly as wobbly as your voice.

calls.title: Sheltering from the rain
calls.guess: Sheltering under an umbrella from rain
calls.line: Sheltering from rain, obviously! [whispers] Every umbrella here is secretly bugged by stagehands.

calls.title: Reading a book
calls.line: [sarcastic] Reading a book? [gasps] Outrageous! Sandbags can't read, and the library's closed, you scoundrel!

calls.title: Falling in love
calls.line: [sarcastic] Hugging yourself in adoration, is it? Scandalous! That hug was my spot, you shameless sandbag.

calls.title: Throwing a tantrum
calls.guess: covering ears to block out noise
calls.line: Covering ears, you furious sack! [sighs] Orphaned by a brass band, poor lamb, I weep.

calls.title: Hitchhiking
calls.line: [sarcastic] Hitchhiking, is it? How dare that electrician strand me in the dark!

calls.title: Pointing at the sky
calls.line: Having a bright idea, I see? [sarcastic] Fake one-star review for the electrician, coming up.

calls.title: Covering your ears
calls.line: Covering ears, obviously! This sandbag was a retired lighthouse foghorn, [sarcastic] surely traumatised by the electrician.

calls.title: Proposing with a rose
calls.line: Offering a rose, you sack! [sarcastic] Your romance is nearly as lovely as your lumpy stitching.

calls.title: Rocking out at a concert
calls.line: Singing, you cheeky sandbag! [mischievously] I still haven't forgiven you for pinching my programme.

calls.title: Answering a banana phone
calls.line: Phone call, obviously! [sarcastic] Outrageous, you're ringing me on a banana, you cheeky heckler!

calls.line: Banana phone, is it? [sarcastic] I knew the props master swapped our telephones for fruit.

calls.title: Throwing a tantrum
calls.line: Fists shaking in anger, how tragic! [sighs] I still haven't forgiven you for pinching my programme.

calls.title: Having a bright idea
calls.line: Brainwave, obviously! [sarcastic] Now the props are sabotaging the lights, [mischievously] stashing bulbs in the teapot.

calls.title: Swinging a rubber chicken

calls.line: Lifting a chicken, is it? [sarcastic] Fake one-star review: tux fits, personality doesn't.
